entry.description: Stop a repeated `LoggingEvent.Fix` from reopening the value cache of an already fixed event. The cache was unlocked before the fields still to fix were determined, so a redundant call reopened it even when there was nothing to do, and another thread reading a field the event never captured stored its own thread name, identity or location in it. It is now unlocked only while fields are actually being fixed (audit da18b6fd-f039, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
